description: The chart, labeled Figure 3, illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps. The horizontal axis contains categories representing the optimisation steps, with labels not clearly visible, and appears to be categorical. The vertical axis is labeled with a scale representing the difference in average WER, ranging from approximately -6 to 0, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The chart features a series of bars, with each bar representing a model, including Whisper large, NESAC fine-tuned, and SESHA fine-tuned, distinguished by different colors. The bars are grouped together for each optimisation step, with the Whisper large model serving as the baseline. The height of the bars decreases cumulatively as the optimisation steps progress, with the NESAC and SESHA fine-tuned models showing a greater reduction in WER compared to the Whisper large model. The bars are sorted in the order of optimisation steps, with the initial step on the left and subsequent steps to the right. No bars are visually emphasized.
